items.reason: A gentle cleanser keeps dry-feeling, low-moisture skin comfortable while it adjusts to a retinol.
A 0.3% retinol is a sensible starting strength for smoothing the look of fine lines and uneven texture, since you aren't using any retinoid yet.
A ceramide moisturizer helps support the look of a comfortable, hydrated skin barrier, which your moisture score suggests could use it.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is needed alongside retinol, which makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: I swapped the 1% serum for 0.3% and left out the retinal eye cream, because starting two retinoids at once, one at high strength, often leads to dryness and irritation; you can add the eye cream after a couple of months if your skin is comfortable. Use the retinol at night just 2 evenings a week at first, building up slowly, then moisturize, and wear the SPF every morning.
